game_ludo_desc: Roll to launch planes; bring all four home
game_monopoly_desc: Buy streets and collect rent to outlast rivals
game_tank_desc: Real-time arena: maneuver and shoot for 3 minutes
game_tetris_desc: Synchronized survival: clear lines and attack
game_xiangqi_desc: Classic Chinese chess: checkmate or stalemate wins
rule_gomoku_2: Connect five horizontally, vertically or diagonally to win.
rule_gomoku_3: Undo the previous move when playing locally.
rule_ludo_1: 2–4 players; each has four planes starting at base.
rule_ludo_2: Roll a 6 to launch, then roll again.
rule_ludo_3: Planes circle the track and enter their home lane.
rule_ludo_4: Landing on an opponent sends their plane back to base.
rule_ludo_5: Reach home with an exact roll; first to finish all four wins.
rule_monopoly_1: 2–5 players roll two dice and move in turns.
rule_monopoly_2: Buy unowned properties; pay rent on opponents’ properties.
rule_monopoly_3: Chance cards trigger random events; passing Start awards 2000.
rule_monopoly_4: Bankruptcy eliminates a player and returns properties to the bank.
rule_monopoly_5: After 30 rounds, the richest player wins; the host may end the match early.
rule_tank_1: A real-time arena for 2–5 players; each tank has 3 HP.
rule_tank_2: Move with the directional controls and fire at any time; everyone acts simultaneously.
rule_tank_3: Hits reduce HP; destroyed tanks respawn after 2 seconds with brief invulnerability.
rule_tank_4: Brick walls break; steel walls do not.
rule_tank_5: The match lasts 3 minutes; ranking uses kills, fewer deaths, then damage.
rule_tetris_1: Synchronized survival for 2–4 players, each with a 10×18 well.
rule_tetris_2: Move, rotate both ways, soft drop, hard drop, and hold pieces.
rule_tetris_3: Clearing lines scores and sends garbage; your clears cancel incoming garbage first.
rule_tetris_4: Topping out from pieces or garbage eliminates you, and targets rotate among survivors.
rule_tetris_5: The last survivor wins; online eliminations and final placement are confirmed by the server.
rule_xiangqi_2: Generals stay in the palace; advisors move diagonally; elephants cannot cross the river.
rule_xiangqi_3: Horses may be blocked; chariots move straight; cannons jump to capture; soldiers gain lateral moves after crossing.
rule_xiangqi_4: Generals may not face; a check must be answered.
rule_xiangqi_5: Checkmate or no legal move wins.

ai_persona_tsundere_desc: “I-it’s not like I’m going easy on you!”
ai_persona_tsundere_think_1: Hmph, as if this position needs thought.
ai_persona_tsundere_think_2: I’m not trying hard because of you…
ai_persona_tsundere_think_3: Fine, I’ll play along for a while.
ai_persona_tsundere_win_1: I didn’t even need my full strength!
ai_persona_tsundere_win_2: Hmph, next time won’t be this easy.
ai_persona_tsundere_lose_1: I-I was only letting you win!
ai_persona_tsundere_lose_2: Don’t get smug. I’ll win the next one!
ai_persona_tsundere_lose_3: That does not count as losing to you!
ai_persona_gambler_think_2: Fortune favors the bold — this move!
ai_persona_gambler_think_3: Luck is on my side today. All in!
ai_persona_gambler_win_1: See? You have to risk it to win!
ai_persona_gambler_win_2: All in — and a huge win!
ai_persona_gambler_lose_2: Another match — I’ll turn it around!
ai_persona_mean_think_2: I could see your move with my eyes closed.
ai_persona_mean_win_1: At this level, a hundred rematches won’t help.
ai_persona_mean_win_3: Bring me a real opponent next time.
ai_persona_mean_lose_2: I got careless. Don’t get smug.
ai_persona_cute_lose_2: I’ll try even harder next time!
ai_persona_teacher_think_1: By probability, this move has the best odds.
ai_persona_teacher_think_3: Choosing the optimum is basic mathematical literacy.
ai_persona_teacher_win_1: The result was determined — that is mathematics.
ai_persona_teacher_win_2: Conclusion: careful calculation does not lose.
ai_persona_teacher_win_3: Next problem — I mean, next match.
ai_persona_teacher_lose_1: The sample was too small. We repeat the experiment.
